extractFailed.title: We could not read the recipe from the photo
extractFailed.photoKept: Your photo will be saved with the recipe either way, even if you fill it in by hand.
extractFailed.offer: Want to fill in the details yourself? The photo stays attached, and only the title and ingredients need you.

reason.handwriting: There is handwriting here, but the letters are too joined or unclear to read with confidence. Better to leave it than to invent ingredients.
reason.blurry: The photo came out blurry or too low resolution. A steadier, closer shot usually fixes it.
reason.dark: The photo is too dark, or glare and shadows are covering the text. Better light will help.
reason.cropped: The text is readable, but the recipe is cut off and not all of it is in frame. Try again with the whole page in view.
reason.empty: No recipe text was found in the photo, just an image or a blank page.
reason.notRecipe: The text in the photo is readable, but it does not look like a recipe.
reason.other: We could not read the content of this photo.
